provenance.source: Undirected coupling edges (0,1), (1,2), (1,3), (3,4) are the Processor A list in the 21-page Universal Challenge Framework (Problem_Statment_Details.pdf, Phase 1 benchmark authority). The same four undirected edges are repeated in Processor_AB_Benchmark_Configuration_FINAL.pdf, which also prints a both-directions simulation list and says that document is for organizer approval. Basis gates rz, sx, x, cx are a local assumption matching the framework example gate set X, SX, Rz, CX. Edge direction is not frozen: the framework lists undirected edges, so this file enables both CX directions. This is not the earlier linear path 0-1-2-3-4.
provenance.noise_source: Illustrative Challenge Guide noise, not an official calibration. The 21-page framework says the organizer-provided processor definitions are the source of truth for the final noise model and simulator settings. Processor_AB_Benchmark_Configuration_FINAL.pdf states that the exact noise parameters are not verified by the processor-map materials.
